S5_reason: Computed trigger requires uniform Q/state/flux defect and no reasonable Pareto order; no S5 implementation was run because the development results retain a reasonable Pareto set.

development_set.held_out_rule: All other catalogue rows, validated only after freezing order and substeps.
development_set.selection_rule: Fixed paper catalogue order: include four mother models and all six known sensitive IDs, then append the first catalogue rows until 18 total. Verify coverage of every ARCH1, ARCH2, QPERC, QSURF option and fixedsiz_2+perc_lower.

plan_deviations: A preliminary held-out run for a pre-correction selection was excluded; final held-out evidence contains only the recomputed development-selected order.

reference.oracle_order_note: pinned Fortran FUSE reference uses its frozen internal sequential order; all candidate orders are compared against this same reference without modifying the oracle

selection_rationale.rule: hard gate first; competition-ranked multi-metric fidelity (Q max/RMSE, state max/median/P95, flux max/median/P95, KGEcomp; weights flux 3, Q 2, state 2, KGE 1); within one score point choose fastest representative forward+backward; lexical tie-break

raw_flux_audit.equations: runtime._fixed_raw_process and dfuse.kernel._sequential_raw_process compared at identical state/forcing/theta/context
